purpose: Evidence archive for bounded handling of a page change between native browser planning and dispatch.
scope: Archive of the bounded redirect-recovery repair: five focused synthetic tests passed across RED/GREEN plus the guard batch; the live city research workflow still failed by requesting unnecessary approval; the exact-request AgentCPM comparison also remained semantically unqualified. Records preserve the boundary between fixture-level recovery evidence and live workflow qualification. Raw model reasoning is excluded.

priorContext.observedProductionFailure: After a native proposal was planned against one document, the page changed before dispatch and the stale proposal failed with pageChanged.
priorContext.proposedRepairBoundary: Bounded pre-dispatch retry only: discard a proposal tied to a stale page, recapture and replan; do not broaden retry behavior or alter model/prompt/decoder semantics.

testFailures.failureText: failed - A stale native proposal must trigger a fresh observation and replan: pageChanged

xcresult.failureTextSummary: A stale native proposal must trigger a fresh observation and replan: pageChanged
xcresult.failureInterpretation: The first reported failure shows the stale proposal was not converted into a fresh observation/replan. The test may report additional expected-result/count failures; this summary is not a complete assertion-by-assertion inventory.

testContract.scenario: A gated native page planner proposes against /start while a local WKWebView client redirect commits /landing. The returned stale proposal must be discarded and replanned against /landing.
testContract.expected: Clarification from the fresh landing page; two native planner calls; no /must-not-open navigation; no visual fallback; retained browser owner.

patchScope.behavior: Catch only a pageChanged error while an unsent native proposal is being produced; validate cancellation and current lease ownership, increment a bounded stale-proposal counter (cap 3), then recapture/replan without adding the rejected proposal to history. Preserve interruption/ownership guards.

greenRun.interpretation: The stale redirect proposal was discarded and the narrow retry/guard focused tests passed; no production-model inference or live city task is included in this run.
